issuer: the Procureur-Generaal (the licence is issued by or on behalf of the Attorney General)
note: Read 2026-10-30 in the texts SRiS (a Paramaribo foundation that publishes Suriname's legislation, sris.sr) posts, each the law as amended to the date it states: the Rijwet (the law of 30 December 1916, G.B. 1917 no. 65, as amended to S.B. 2001 no. 6) and the Rijbesluit 1957 (G.B. 1957 no. 103, as amended to S.B. 2005 no. 17). Rijwet art. 7(1)3o: a driving licence is issued 'door of vanwege de Procureur-Generaal'; art. 9(2)1o b: no licence for motor vehicles other than two-wheelers to anyone under eighteen; art. 15(1): a licence is valid for ten consecutive years from the day of issue, each time. The fee: Rijbesluit art. 37c(1) issues a licence only on payment of the examination's costs (for a B-E licence SRD 140 for the whole examination); that is the test's fee, not an issuing fee, so the fee stands null (art. 37c(3), SRD 50 for a renewal, isn't the first issue's either). The licence's name 'B-E' is the Rijbesluit's (art. 37c(1)2o, art. 36a). Readings to check: the texts are SRiS's consolidations, not the Staatsblad itself (which isn't online); later amendments of the Rijbesluit exist (S.B. 2013 nos. 122, 179 and 203, S.B. 2016 no. 147, S.B. 2023 no. 2, the last a scan without text) and weren't all read (S.B. 2013 no. 179, read, changes the licence's model and the particulars it carries); no amendment of the Rijwet after 2001 was found. The Korps Politie Suriname's site (politie.sr) answered but has no licence page.

sources.title: Rijwet (wet van 30 december 1916, G.B. 1917 no. 65, as amended to S.B. 2001 no. 6), SRiS
sources.said: S.B. 2001 no. 6. ... door of vanwege de Procureur-Generaal is afgegeven een rijbewijs voor het besturen van een motorrijtuig ... aan hem, die de leeftijd van achttien jaren niet heeft bereikt, indien de aanvraag betreft een rijbewijs voor het besturen van andere motorrijtuigen; ... telkens geldig voor de duur van tien achtereenvolgende jaren, gerekend van de dag van afgifte af.
